reviews.text:
I have been taking my cats to Deer Creek Animal hospital for years, and haven't left a review yet. I found the vets extraordinary, especially with the passing of my two elderly cats...they had a lovely quiet room for that.

But what prompted me to finally write a review is that I just got off the phone with a receptionist named ARI who spent a half-hour with me navigating how to bring in my cat who is part-feral. I needed to itemize a number of needs: on-site sedation, comprehensive physical, teeth cleaning, possible x-rays, etc.

ARI was the most pleasant, patient, and kindest people I have ever come across to handle this situation. She went above and beyond to help me. THANK YOU, Ari. I hope she's there for a long time.

I also want to give high fives to the rest of the staff, because they  really do a great job. If you are searching for a vet, make sure to filter out all the places that are corporate owned...Deer Creek is NOT that. Simply wonderful. Thanks, guys.
Dr. Gross is absolutely incredible. I will continue to come see her for years to come! Love this office. They usually have quick availability as well for more urgent issues.

Always 5 star service at Deer Creek. We have been taking our dogs here for years and we appreciate the level of care for our pets. Whether it is daycare or veterinary services we have always walked away with a positive experience. Thank you for always taking such great care of our crazy boys.

I want to start by saying that I have been going to Deer Creek Animal Hospital for more than 20 years. In the old location on Cave Creek Rd with Dr. Higgins.

Three weeks ago today I said goodbye to the love of my life Eddie. It's not the first baby I have said goodbye to but this one is hitting so hard. I was not even prepared for the level of care, compassion and support I received. Eddie was my first rescue and had severe PTSD and fear issues so appointments got a little stressful so I stopped going. Because he hadn't been seen in a bit they required him to be examined.

We were first seen by Nadia and she listened to me and took her notes. She was so sweet and seemed to really listen and never interrupted me....and I can tend to go on and on. Then came Dr. Gross and her and Nadia were able to put his little muzzle on with minimal stress to him and me. The doctor did an exam and observed and listen to all my concerns with care and no judgement. She spent so much time with us and in the end gave her support to my very difficult decision. She explained each step and gave me time between, never, ever rushed anything.

I also want to give a shout out to the employee who took my call, Antonio. I originally went in to make the appointment and it didn't go how I thought it would go although she was very nice. I left in a bit of a huff because I was afraid based on our conversation regarding needing to be examined first that there could potentially be a second appointment. My life with Eddie was spent trying to avoid stress or trauma to both of us.

Once I got home and took a deep breath I called and that's when I spoke with Antonio. He was amazing and not only answered my questions but fully explained why the doctor needed to see Eddie and that if the decision was made it could be done same day. He was gentle in his tone and so compassionate. I hung up feeling so much better. I think he should be responsible for training any new employees!

All in all, at least for that appointment I wish I could give more than 5 stars. Thank you so much, Dr. Gross, Nadia & Antonio.

Rest in Peace Eddie
9/18/15 - 11/20/25

We are visiting here and our girl Ellie needed to be seen for a couple of issues. We got in the same day. Everyone was helpful, friendly and professional. The vet gave us very helpful information on one of her issues that other vet told us. He involved us in her treatment plan.

Both the tech and the vet were very knowledgeable they were able to check Rini I thought she had a tick and they told me it was a wart and they also gave her a physical she is 15 years old they were very gentle with her and she doesn't move too well and she is very heavy. They did a great job!

Pepper loves his new friends at Deer Creek Animal Hospital! ❤️
Angel did the grooming and gave our boy the cutest cute, and he was so happy to meet so many new friends! I've already recommended Angel to some friends. Thank you so much!
Deer Creek got us in on Saturday on an emergency basis when our dog woke up acting very ill. Dr. Gross was excellent and took a lot of time examining him and answering our questions.

Been a customer since 2021.  Dr. Balsino is so kind and gentle with our pets.  He takes time to explain things and is so patient.  I trust him with my babies and thats saying a lot.  Definitely recommend.

Friendly and very knowledgeable service.  I thought my 13-yr old large dog was ready to be put down, because he couldn’t get up or walk without falling even if he had assistance.  But mentally I could see he wanted to live; He just didn’t understand why his legs didn’t work anymore.

Dr. Balsino’s recommendation to try steroids was a lifesaver.  Even on a very low dose, my big fella can now get up and walk and even jog, without any assistance.  His good quality of life seems prolonged for probably a year and maybe more.  Every extra day with him is a blessing!

I took my cat Lynx to Deer Creek Animal Hospital for almost a decade. They were helpful in treating her hyperactive thyroid for the last five years. They also gave her a monthly arthritis injections for the past year or two, and the occasional grooming/trimming of nails when PetSmart refused to do anything.

So why the one star? Long read ahead.

This past week, I had to take my cat to VetMed, a nearby ER vet, because of an emergency involving her not eating/drinking and losing weight rapidly. She spent hours there getting re-hydrated and getting tested to find out what was wrong. They suspected her thyroid and helped me get some medicine to stimulate her appetite and encourage her to eat/drink. Records went to Deer Creek that same day.

Wednesday of this past week, I called Deer Creek because I wanted to bring Lynx in to talk about long-term care. They refused to make an appointment for her that day, and said the nearest they could do was next day. But later that same day, I took her back to VetMed because she was, again, not eating or drinking and slowing down. This time they did an ultrasound as part of their tests, and found it was Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), with possible Lymphoma. It had been going on for years; her colon had shrank by 40% and she was in constant pain. This was also forwarded to Deer Creek, and I called and asked them to have a vet call me to talk about this more, to which the receptionist agreed they would call the next day.

No call on Thursday. I called, and got voicemail.

No call on Friday. I called and was on hold for fifteen minutes. Then I was told the vet refused to speak to me until Lynx came in for physical exams and blood tests.

They wanted me to drag in my 20 year-old cat for yet another vet visit, the third in less than a week, with more blood draws and exams, and flat-out refused to address the underlying problems or even hear me out on my concerns.

I set up an appointment with a different vet, the Four Legged Friends. But it wasn't meant to be. Lynx had to be taken in to VetMed this past Monday, and this time it was too much to treat. She was put to sleep, in my arms from start to finish, as she had been in my arms for countless hours over the past twenty years.

Deer Creek Animal Hospital didn't care about my cat. They didn't run what is apparently a very basic diagnostic for the problems my cat had been having that I had been telling them about for years involving her digestion. Said it was normal. Wish I had known this test was an option.

I doubt they could have done much during the last week of Lynx's life, but I -do- know that they should have done this test in the years leading up to her eventual decline. If they had cared to, Lynx might still be alive today.

The simple fact of the matter is, if Lynx were a dog they would have caught this. They treat their dogs like royalty. They give them private exam rooms, offer their owners water, talk with them as long as the owner wants to. Even let the dogs hang out in the front office and pee everywhere they like. That damn office always smells like dog pee. As far as I can tell, they do everything right by their dogs.

My cat? Exam rooms rarely, while their dogs barked and brayed and scared her. Never offered water or even a kind word. Appointments usually ran late. When I would talk to a vet, it was like they didn't have the time of day for me and were humoring my questions because I was paying them. One time they even gave her monthly arthritis injection to another pet, and she had to go for a week past her recommended dosage period before they could get another. Probably gave it to a dog that just happened to come in that day and the owner wanted it. More things I wish I had realized sooner.

G Reviews has a word limit, and I'm coming up on it, so here's the key takeaways: I place squarely at their feet the blame for Lynx's IBD going undiagnosed for such a long time, and their frankly appalling unequal treatment of cats. I recommend cat owners stay away, and find a vet that actually cares about felines. It's not here.

We took our cat in for annual vaccinations and were delighted with each member of the staff we encountered.  We were most impressed with the impression that the personnel all liked their specific responsibilities and were happy they worked there.

That says it all "The employees were happy with the organization".

Kudos
Deer Creek Animal Hospital is awesome! I've been bringing my dogs here for 15 years. My last appointment was with Dr. Gross, she's a great Vet!
Staff is friendly and they take good care of my veterinarian needs.  I have also used their dog boarding services and they do a great job.

Desert Creek Animal Hospital really helped us out yesterday. Our normal Vet was closed on a Friday and they were able to get us in. Dr. Wheeler was on call and he happens to be our favorite vet of all time. The front desk staff was super friendly and the vet tech was great. Thanks DCAH!
